#include <bits/stdc++.h>
using namespace std;

const long long MOD = 998244353;
vector<long long> factorials, invFactorials;

long long add_mod(long long a, long long b) {
    return (a + b) % MOD;
}

long long subtract_mod(long long a, long long b) {
    return ((a - b) % MOD + MOD) % MOD;
}

long long multiply_mod(long long a, long long b) {
    return (a * b) % MOD;
}

long long fast_pow(long long base, long long exp) {
    long long result = 1;
    long long cur = base % MOD;
    while (exp > 0) {
        if (exp & 1) result = multiply_mod(result, cur);
        cur = multiply_mod(cur, cur);
        exp >>= 1;
    }
    return result;
}

void precompute() {
    factorials.resize(1000000);
    invFactorials.resize(1000000);
    factorials[0] = 1;
    for (int i = 1; i < 1000000; i++) {
        factorials[i] = multiply_mod(factorials[i - 1], i);
    }
    invFactorials[999999] = fast_pow(factorials[999999], MOD - 2);
    for (int i = 999998; i >= 0; i--) {
        invFactorials[i] = multiply_mod(invFactorials[i + 1], i + 1);
    }
}

long long computeCombination(int n, int k) {
    return multiply_mod(factorials[n], multiply_mod(invFactorials[k], invFactorials[n - k]));
}

long long calculatePower(int base, long long exponent) {
    long long total = 0;
    for (int i = 0; i < base; i++) {
        long long term = multiply_mod(fast_pow(base - i, exponent), computeCombination(base, i));
        if (i % 2 == 0) {
            total = add_mod(total, term);
        } else {
            total = subtract_mod(total, term);
        }
    }
    return total;
}

int main() {
    ios::sync_with_stdio(false);
    cin.tie(nullptr);
    precompute();
    int totalN, totalK;
    cin >> totalN >> totalK;
    if (totalK == 0) {
        cout << factorials[totalN] << "\n";
        return 0;
    }
    if (totalK >= totalN) {
        cout << 0 << "\n";
        return 0;
    }
    int remaining = totalN - totalK;
    long long assignWays = calculatePower(remaining, totalN);
    long long pickWays = computeCombination(totalN, remaining);
    long long totalWays = multiply_mod(assignWays, pickWays);
    cout << multiply_mod(totalWays, 2) << "\n";
    return 0;
}
</translated_code>
